summary: The gentilic יְבוּסִי identifies a member of the people of Jebus. Genesis uses the definite singular collectively when listing the peoples descended from Canaan.

senses.definition: A member of the people of Jebus, or collectively the people themselves.

evidence.note: The singular gentilic names a people alongside the Amorites and Girgashites in Canaan’s genealogy.
The travelers approach יְבוּס, identified as Jerusalem, and the servant calls it the city of הַיְבוּסִי.
